title: On the Phone
subtitle: Sound professional on every call
description: Phone conversations can be tricky when you're speaking a second language. These phrases cover the most common situations you'll face, from answering professionally to dealing with a bad connection.
tip: Speak a little slower than you think you need to — on the phone, without visual cues, clarity matters more than speed.
phrases: Hi, this is Jordan speaking — how can I help you?
Could you hold for just a moment while I pull up your account?
I'm sorry, could you spell your last name for me, please?
I'm having trouble hearing you — the connection seems a bit poor.
Would you mind speaking up a little? I can barely hear you.
I just want to confirm our appointment for Monday at two o'clock.
I'll have someone call you back within the hour.
Is there anything else I can help you with before we hang up?
